**Coaching note:** 
When your opponent's king lacks an escape square, look for forcing checks with your heavy pieces. Here, Qxh3+ forces Nh2 to block the check, then Qg2 is checkmate because the king on h1 has no flight squares. Always scan for back-rank weaknesses and forced sequences after tactical checks.
